x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment - the-decision-as-a-walked-process task 9.1 (REQ-DWP-009). A route step may let the requester name its approver, bounded by a Nextcloud group: `nominationGroup` on the ApprovalRoute step. ApprovalNomination checks the nominee is in that group when the route is sent and writes the nominee as the step's person; ApprovalRouteStepMapper copies the bound onto the stage, and `nominatedBy` records who named the approver. Properties only, so no schema version moves, as in 137-a-committee-step-names-its-body.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The ordered steps, with the walked-process additions. Every addition defaults to today's behaviour, so no stored route changes meaning.

nominationGroup.title: Nominated from group
nominationGroup.description: When set, the person who sends the route names this step's approver, and that person must be a member of this Nextcloud group. A nomination outside the group is refused. When empty, the step keeps its own actor and any nomination sent to it is ignored (REQ-DWP-009).

nominationGroup.title: Nominated from group
nominationGroup.description: The group the approver of this stage was nominated from. COPIED onto the stage at instantiation, not read back off the route (REQ-AR-012).

nominatedBy.title: Nominated by
nominatedBy.description: The user who named this stage's approver when the route was sent (REQ-DWP-009).
